15.1 Versioning & Changelog – Overview

The ABpE Portal follows a semantic versioning scheme (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Changes are documented in a changelog.

15.2 Version 3.0 (current – May 2026)

Version 3.0 is a major release with fundamental architectural changes and new features.

New Features:

  • Modular Architecture with module.json: Each function is an independent module with its own configuration. Modules can be developed and deployed independently.
  • i18n Language System (DE/EN/FR): Full internationalization of all texts. New languages can be integrated by adding JSON files – without code changes.
  • Dark Mode Theme System: Support for light and dark mode with system preference detection. User settings are stored in the database.
  • Multi-User with Roles: Integration of Django's authentication system with an extended ConsultantProfile. Roles: Consultant, Supervisor, Dispatcher, Admin.
  • Backup/Restore Helper: CLI tool for backing up and restoring files with version management and metadata.
  • Responsive Design (Mobile First): Fully responsive user interface with bottom navigation for mobile devices.
  • Prefix Convention for CSS/JS: Uniform naming (core-, ui-, mod-, api-, lib-) for better maintainability.

Changed / Improved Features:

  • Generic Views and URLs: No manual entries in views.py or urls.py for new modules required anymore.
  • Dynamic Sidebar: Navigation is automatically generated from module.json files.
  • Improved Help System: Module-specific help texts in JSON files.
  • API Endpoints Extended: New endpoints for language switching and user settings.

Fixed Bugs:

  • Fixed: Subpages in the sidebar are now displayed correctly
  • Fixed: Language switching works without page reload
  • Fixed: 403 Forbidden on API calls (CSRF exceptions)
  • Fixed: Module scanner finds modules at any depth

15.3 Version 2.0 (April 2026)

Version 2.0 was the first major release with the basic modular concept.

  • Initial dashboard with statistics cards
  • Basic module system with module.json
  • Simple i18n system (DE/EN only)
  • Basic theme system (light mode only)
  • First API endpoints (/stats/, /system/)

15.4 Version 1.0 (April 2026 – initial)

First base version of the ABpE Portal.

  • Functional dashboard
  • Login/Logout functionality
  • Basic user management
  • Static pages for documentation
